review_corrections.issue: Stage overwrites server startRow/endRow without checking them, allowing recorded server boundaries to be lost or replaced.
review_corrections.correction: Require every nonnil server row boundary to match local before PATCH; permit nil-server to recorded-local advancement. Extract existing checks into the production canStage policy used by the repository and regression tests.

review_corrections.issue: Active occurrence merge starts from local tank sessions and can discard remote startRow or accept conflicting endRow.
review_corrections.correction: Preserve remote startRow when local lacks it; hold differing nonnil start/end row boundaries before invoking the existing merge. Do not change shared legacy merge policy.

review_corrections.issue: Checked-in trips_set_updated_at calls set_updated_at, which changes updated_at but does not advance sync_version; a version-only predicate cannot detect every existing writer.
review_corrections.correction: Read typed Trip and raw updated_at from the same scoped authenticated response. Predicate PATCH on raw updated_at plus sync_version, identity, vineyard, undeleted, active and unended state. Preserve PostgreSQL microseconds verbatim. Payload still contains tank_sessions only.
